title: After dark
steps: Deep night in the castle, the fire out, everyone asleep; a very soft knock at the common room's door. You sit up in bed.
The two of you tiptoe across the common room to the door, and you open it.

I could not sleep. Look what was folded inside the old book I took out of the library this afternoon, looking for something about the passages: the naughty child's map, the whole castle floor by floor in numbered cells, drawn years ago by a pupil who slipped out at night, with a word in its corner, *orvim*, that makes it work. Take it, you read it while I watch the way.
The older pupils say the passages change at night, and Dask patrols them so that no one is out of bed.
That is why the map: it says where everything is. We look before every step. Are you coming?
Not sure... all right, let's go. But if Dask sees us, straight back to bed.
The three of you slip out into the corridor; the stone is cold under your bare feet; {friend} goes first.
